keyPoints: Janan (reproduction) se jeev apne jaise naye jeev paida karte hain — ye prakriya prajati ko khatm hone se bachaye rakhti hai.
Alaingik janan me ek hi janak hota hai aur yugmak nahi bante — ameeba me dwikhandan (do tukde) aur hydra me mukulan (kali nikalna) hota hai.
Laingik janan me nar aur mada yugmak milkar yugmanaj (zygote) banate hain, jisse bhroon banta hai; isme dono janakon ke gun aate hain.
Pushp paudhe ka janan ang hai — paragan (parag ka vartikagra par pahunchna) ke baad nishechan hota hai aur andashay beej me badal jaata hai.
Manav me nishechan sharir ke andar hota hai; bhroon ka vikas garbhashay me lagbhag nau mahine tak hota hai aur maa se poshan milta hai.
Janan ke dauran DNA ki nakal me chhoti-chhoti bhinnataen aa jaati hain — yehi vividhata jeevon ko badalte vatavaran me jeene aur vikas ki raah deti hai.
Aam galti: beej ko phal samajhna; beej andashay ke andar ke beejand se banta hai, jabki phal andashay ki deewar se banta hai — aam ka guthla beej hai.

title: Jeevon me Janan
